free_tier_summary: Hobby plan; verify the bandwidth quota manually.
headline: Frontend hosting + edge functions on Vercel's global network.
name: Vercel
notes: Best-in-class Next.js host. Commercial-use restrictions on Hobby plan.

free_tier_summary: Free Web Services; verify quota manually.
headline: Web services + Postgres + Static Sites
name: Render
notes: Free Web Services spin down after 15 min idle. Postgres free tier expires after 90 days.

free_tier_summary: Free tier with daily request cap; verify the exact RPD.
headline: Very fast Llama / Mixtral / Whisper inference
name: Groq
notes: Fastest hosted LLM inference. Quotas reset daily.

eligibility_summary: Any new Azure account; CC required
free_tier_summary: Three layers: $200 USD credits for 30 days, 12-Months-Free (B1S Linux/Windows VM 750h/mo, 64 GB SSD, 5 GB Blob, 250 GB SQL DB), Always-Free (App Service 10 apps, Functions 1M req, Cosmos DB 1000 RU + 25 GB, Cognitive Services free tiers).
headline: Azure free account — $200 / 30-day credits + 12-month-free + 25+ always-free services.
name: Microsoft Azure Free
notes: Central India + South India + West India regions all supported on free tier. AI services (Translator, Computer Vision, Speech) have generous always-free transaction quotas — the most underrated free AI in the market.

free_tier_summary: Free tier: T4/L4 GPU (~12 hr/day, dynamic), 12 GB RAM. Disconnects on inactivity.
headline: Free Jupyter notebooks with T4 / L4 GPU access.
name: Google Colab
notes: Best free GPU for ML experimentation. Sessions terminate on idle.

free_tier_summary: Free `:free` model variants (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Gemini Flash). Per-model RPM caps.
headline: Unified API; many free models from multiple labs.
name: OpenRouter
notes: Drop-in OpenAI-compatible. Free models are rate-limited.

free_tier_summary: $1 starter credit + select `Free` serverless models (Llama 8B Turbo, FLUX schnell). Pay-as-you-go after.
headline: Hosted Llama / FLUX / Mixtral with $1 free credit + free serverless models.
name: Together AI
notes: OpenAI-compatible API. Image gen via FLUX-schnell-Free.

free_tier_summary: Small monthly free compute. After: pay-per-second on GPU instances.
headline: Hosted image / video / audio gen (FLUX, SDXL, SVD, Whisper).
name: Replicate
notes: Easiest one-line API for image / video. Free quota is small.

free_tier_summary: Free tier on Cerebras Inference: Llama 3.1 8B / 70B + 3.3 70B with daily token cap. Sometimes via waitlist.
headline: Very fast Llama 3.1 / 3.3 inference (~2,000+ tok/s).
name: Cerebras
notes: Among fastest LLM inference; free tier subject to waitlist gates.

free_tier_summary: Free tier: Mistral 7B / Mistral Small / Codestral with rate limits. Free embeddings.
headline: Mistral + Codestral + Mistral Embed free tier API.
name: Mistral La Plateforme
notes: Strong code model. May require Indian phone for OTP.

free_tier_summary: Signup credits + free quota on selected fast models.
headline: Fast image + video gen (FLUX-schnell, SDXL, AnimateDiff).
name: fal.ai
notes: Best for sub-second image generation. TTS + STT also available.

free_tier_summary: Free: 500 MB Postgres, 1 GB storage, 50k MAU auth, 2 active projects. Pauses after 7 days idle.
headline: Postgres + Auth + Storage + Realtime. 500 MB DB, 2 active projects.
name: Supabase
notes: Easiest path to a full Postgres + auth stack.

free_tier_summary: Free: 0.5 GB storage, 1 always-active branch, autoscaling compute. Branch like git.
headline: Serverless Postgres with branching. 0.5 GB storage, autoscaling compute.
name: Neon
notes: Auto-scales to zero. Branching makes preview-env Postgres trivial.

free_tier_summary: Free: 10 GB storage/month, 1M Class A ops, 10M Class B ops, $0 egress.
headline: S3-compatible object storage with zero egress fees.
name: Cloudflare R2
notes: Zero egress is a structural win for content-heavy apps.

free_tier_summary: Free: 10 GB storage, free Class B daily caps, free egress to Cloudflare via Bandwidth Alliance.
headline: S3-compatible object storage. 10 GB free + free egress to Cloudflare.
name: Backblaze B2
notes: Cheaper-than-S3 cold storage. Pairs well with Cloudflare R2.

free_tier_summary: Free: 10,000 MAU, social login, 2FA, magic links, basic user management.
headline: Drop-in auth + user management with social login + 2FA.
name: Clerk
notes: Pre-built React components; fastest path to working auth.

free_tier_summary: Free: 25,000 MAU, social + db connections, MFA, basic actions.
headline: Identity platform with 25,000 MAU on free tier.
name: Auth0
notes: Most generous MAU on a free tier among hosted auth.

free_tier_summary: Free: 5k errors, 10M tracing spans, 50 replays / month. 1 user / project. Source maps + releases.
headline: Error monitoring + tracing. 5k errors / 10M spans free monthly.
name: Sentry
notes: Default for JS / Python error monitoring.

free_tier_summary: Free: 10k Prometheus series, 50 GB logs, 50 GB traces, 14-day retention. 3 user seats.
headline: Metrics + logs + traces. 10k Prometheus series + 50 GB logs free.
name: Grafana Cloud
notes: Best free metrics + logs combo. 14-day retention is the catch.

free_tier_summary: Activate Founders: $1k credit + 1 yr Business Support. Activate Portfolio (via VC/accelerator): up to $100k.
headline: Up to $100k AWS credits for eligible startups.
name: AWS Activate
notes: Indian startups eligible. Apply via AWS console with company details.

free_tier_summary: Stripe Atlas (US/Delaware C-Corp incorporation, $500 fee) unlocks alumni perks: AWS Activate $5k, Stripe processing waived first $50k, Notion / Brex / 1Password / Mercury credits.
headline: Quiet perk pack for Stripe Atlas alumni: AWS / Stripe / Notion / 1Password discounts.
name: Stripe Atlas
notes: Indian founders can incorporate via Atlas (Delaware C-Corp) — common path for India-to-US startups.

free_tier_summary: Up to ₹4 lakh proof-of-concept + ₹7 lakh prototype grant via TIDE 2.0 incubators.
headline: Indian govt incubation + grant for tech startups (AI / IoT focus).
name: MeitY TIDE 2.0
notes: Tech-focused. Apply via TIDE incubators (51 across India).

free_tier_summary: $500k on standard SAFE ($125k for 7% + $375k uncapped MFN). 3-month program. Open to global founders.
headline: $500k investment + 3-month program. Open to global founders.
name: Y Combinator
notes: Indian founders welcome. Two batches/year. Highly competitive.

free_tier_summary: Stipend + $100k pre-seed cheque on graduation. Residency in major cities (Bangalore, Singapore, NY, London).
headline: Day-zero VC. $100k cheque, 6-month residency program.
name: Antler
notes: Bangalore cohort runs multiple times/year. Equity-investment, not grant.

free_tier_summary: Pages: unlimited static, 500 builds/month. Workers: 100k req/day, 10ms CPU. R2: 10 GB. D1 SQL: 5 GB.
headline: Edge serverless with 100k requests/day, 10ms CPU per request.
name: Cloudflare Workers
notes: Most generous edge platform free tier. Edge-only runtime (no Node APIs).
tier_fit_rationale: Free quota generous for hobby + small production workloads. 10ms CPU/request is the constraint — fine for stateless functions, edge auth, simple APIs.

free_tier_summary: Free trial $5 credit; pay-as-you-go after. Small apps fit in trial indefinitely.
headline: App hosting close to users (global edge VMs).
name: Fly.io
notes: No always-free tier as of 2026. Trial credit only.

free_tier_summary: 30 hrs/week GPU (P100 or 2x T4), 20 hrs/week TPU. 16 GB RAM.
headline: Free P100 / T4 GPU + TPU notebooks, 30 hrs/week.
name: Kaggle Notebooks
notes: Most stable free GPU; persistent sessions.

free_tier_summary: Gemini 2.0 Flash: ~1500 req/day free. Vision-capable. 1M context window.
headline: Gemini Flash / Pro free API — text + vision + 1M context.

limits.data_used_for_training: Free tier inputs may be used to improve models
limits.regions: Global (with regional residency on paid tier)

name: Google AI Studio
notes: Most generous free vision-capable LLM.
tier_fit_rationale: Most generous free RPD for vision-capable LLM. Gemini 2.0 Flash + 1.5 Pro both have free tiers usable for hobby AND personal-tool production.

free_tier_summary: Free with rate caps; covers text / image / embedding / STT / TTS via Inference API. Free Spaces hosting on CPU.
headline: Serverless inference for 100k+ open models. Spaces with 16 GB RAM CPU.
name: Hugging Face
notes: Best for trying many models without lock-in.

free_tier_summary: M0 free cluster: 512 MB storage, shared CPU/RAM. No CC required.
headline: Hosted MongoDB free tier. 512 MB shared cluster.
name: MongoDB Atlas
notes: Standard for document-store free tier.

free_tier_summary: Public repos: unlimited. Private: 2000 Linux min/month.
headline: CI/CD minutes for public repos unlimited; 2,000 min/mo for private.
name: GitHub Actions
notes: Default cron runner for free agentic pipelines.

free_tier_summary: Start tier: $2k credits + Workspace + AI tools. Scale tier: up to $200k.
headline: Up to $200k GCP credits over 2 years.
name: Google Cloud for Startups
notes: Indian startups eligible. Equity-free.

free_tier_summary: Up to ₹20 lakh as grant for proof-of-concept; up to ₹50 lakh as convertible debenture/debt.
headline: Indian govt seed grant up to ₹50 lakh (~$60k).

limits.grant_purpose: Proof of concept / prototype / product trials

name: Startup India Seed Fund
notes: DPIIT-recognized startups only. Disbursed via incubators.
restrictions: Eligible only for DPIIT-recognized startups < 2 years old, incorporated in India, not derived from a separation/restructuring of an existing business. Specific sectors prioritized.
tier_fit_rationale: India-only grant from DPIIT-recognized incubators. Up to ₹20 lakh as grant for PoC/prototype + up to ₹50 lakh as convertible debt for market entry. Reduces equity dilution massively.

free_tier_summary: Free monthly credits across the NVIDIA model catalog. Many models reset daily.
headline: Generous credits across 100+ hosted models (Llama, Mistral, FLUX, Nemotron).
name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
notes: Huge catalog (text / vision / image / video / embed / TTS).

free_tier_summary: Free tier on SambaNova Cloud with Llama 3 405B / 70B / 8B at fast token rates.
headline: Fast Llama 3 405B / 70B free RPD.
name: SambaNova Cloud
notes: Good quality, very fast tokens. Free tier subject to fair use.

free_tier_summary: Free tier: 50M tokens lifetime across voyage-3-lite + voyage-code + others.
headline: Best-in-class embeddings (voyage-3, voyage-code, multilingual).
name: Voyage AI
notes: Strong for retrieval / RAG. Code-specific embedding models.

free_tier_summary: Free trial key with rate-limited access to Embed v3, Rerank, Command R. Production uses paid keys.
headline: Free trial keys for embeddings + rerank + chat.
name: Cohere
notes: Best free Rerank API. Trial keys; production needs paid key.

free_tier_summary: Free: 10,000 characters/month TTS, voice cloning limited, 3 custom voices.
headline: High-quality TTS (10k characters/month free).
name: ElevenLabs
notes: Best TTS quality. Free tier locks commercial use of cloned voices.

free_tier_summary: $200 signup credit (~750 hrs of Nova-2 transcription). After: pay per minute.
headline: STT + diarization with $200 free signup credit.
name: Deepgram
notes: Generous signup credit. Strong real-time STT.

free_tier_summary: Tier 1-4 model: starts $1k Azure → up to $150k. GitHub Enterprise + Azure OpenAI access. No equity.
headline: Up to $150k Azure credits + free GitHub Enterprise + OpenAI access.
name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
notes: Indian startups eligible. Equity-free. Includes Azure OpenAI access.

free_tier_summary: Cloud credits (AWS / Azure / GCP), mentorship, investor connects, sectoral tracks (DeepTech, AI). Multi-stage support.
headline: India's largest startup ecosystem program — mentorship + cloud credits + investor connect.
name: NASSCOM 10,000 Startups
notes: Run by NASSCOM. Apply via their cohort calendar.

free_tier_summary: Subsidised access to 10,000+ GPUs. Grants for AI startups. Free access to AI Kosh datasets + IndiaAI Innovation Centre.
headline: Indian govt AI mission — compute access + grants + datasets.
name: IndiaAI Mission (MeitY)
notes: ₹10,372 crore allocation across 5 years. Compute via empanelled cloud partners.

free_tier_summary: API credits + technical support + featured-startup spotlight. Not publicly disclosed amount; reports of $5k-$25k Claude API credits typical.
headline: Free Claude API credits for early-stage startups. Most founders never apply.
name: Anthropic Startup Program
notes: Underused — the 'most founders never apply' line is real. Application via Anthropic site.

free_tier_summary: Two tracks: Convergence (deep-tech, $1M+ credits with VC partner) and Founders (general, ~$2.5k API credits + GPT-4 access).
headline: OpenAI API credits + quota increases for funded startups.
name: OpenAI Startup Program
notes: Convergence is invite-only via accelerator partners. Founders track is direct apply.

free_tier_summary: Up to $2,500 Vercel credits + 2-year Pro plan + dedicated support + co-marketing. Stacks with the standard free Hobby tier.
headline: Vercel Pro credits + priority support + GTM perks for accelerator-backed startups.
name: Vercel for Startups
notes: Distinct from the always-free Hobby tier — this is a startup-tier credit program.

free_tier_summary: $5k Supabase credits + Pro plan features + priority engineering support. Coexists with the always-free 500 MB DB tier.
headline: Supabase Pro credits + onboarding for early-stage startups.
name: Supabase for Startups
notes: VC-partner referral typically required. Apply via the Supabase Startups page.

free_tier_summary: Pro plan ($9/mo value) free for OSS maintainers — ZeroGPU access, larger Spaces, private models. Apply with a short OSS-impact form.
headline: Free Pro for qualifying open-source ML projects.
name: Hugging Face Pro (OSS)
notes: Distinct from the free HF Inference tier (already separate). For OSS founders only.

free_tier_summary: Up to $100k DO credits over 12 months + 1-on-1 architect support + community access. Covers Droplets, Spaces, Kubernetes, App Platform, Functions.
headline: $100k DigitalOcean credits for early-stage startups + technical mentorship.
name: DigitalOcean Hatch
notes: Bangalore + Mumbai DO regions available — best India latency among hyperscalers' startup programs.

free_tier_summary: Pro/Business plan free for 12 months + significant Workers/R2/AI Gateway credits + access to private SaaS Connect. Stacks with always-free Workers/Pages tiers.
headline: Free Cloudflare Pro/Business + Workers, R2, AI Gateway, Stream credits.
name: Cloudflare for Startups
notes: Distinct from cloudflare-workers always-free tier. Apply via partner accelerators or directly.
tier_fit_rationale: Targets VC-backed teams already shipping; not for hobbyists. Pre-seed bootstrappers should use the always-free cloudflare-workers row instead.

free_tier_summary: Airtable Pro plan ($24/user/mo value) free for 1 year. Up to 5 seats. Quick-apply form — most who apply are accepted.
headline: Full Airtable Pro free for qualifying early-stage startups, no questions asked.
name: Airtable for Startups
notes: Easiest perk to claim — application is short, approval rate high per founder reports.

free_tier_summary: Up to ₹10 crore (₹1 cr/year for 5 yrs) per incubator. Founders apply via Atal Incubation Centre (AIC) network — IITs, IIITs, IIMs, NIDs.
headline: Govt-of-India incubator network — Atal Incubation Centres + Atal Tinkering Labs.
name: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)
notes: Apply through one of the 70+ Atal Incubation Centres rather than directly to AIM.

free_tier_summary: Cohort programs (Lab32, RUBRIX, MACH33) with workspace, mentorship, ₹5L–₹50L grants depending on track. Strong corporate partnerships (Microsoft, Boeing, Bosch, Reliance).
headline: Hyderabad incubator — sector cohorts + Govt of Telangana subsidies + corporate access.
name: T-Hub (Telangana)
notes: Largest startup incubator in India by floor area. DPIIT registration recommended before applying.

eligibility_summary: Any new AWS account; CC required
free_tier_summary: Three layers: Always Free (Lambda 1M req/mo, DynamoDB 25 GB, CloudFront 1 TB egress), 12-Months-Free (EC2 t2.micro 750h/mo, S3 5 GB, RDS db.t2.micro 750h/mo), Trials (SageMaker 250h/mo for 2 mo, etc.). Generous enough for a personal SaaS first year.
headline: AWS free tier — always-free + 12-month-free across 100+ services for any new account.

limits.regions: All public AWS regions including ap-south-1 (Mumbai)

name: AWS Free Tier
notes: 12-month clock starts at sign-up; expires regardless of usage. Set billing alerts BEFORE you launch. Mumbai (ap-south-1) supported on most free-tier services.
restrictions: Only US East (N. Virginia) for some services. Many free quotas are per-region, not global. Crossing into paid usage doesn't trigger a hard stop — set billing alerts.

sub_offerings.headline: Lambda 1M req/mo, DynamoDB 25 GB, CloudFront 1 TB egress, SNS/SQS/SES
EC2 t2.micro 750h, S3 5 GB, RDS 750h, EBS 30 GB, ELB 750h
SageMaker 250h/mo for 2 mo, Redshift dc2.large 750h for 2 mo

tier_fit_rationale: Always-free is genuinely always-free; 12-month is the bigger win for hobby + personal. Startup-mvp can run a real product on it for the first year. Past year-1 you must qualify for AWS Activate credits or move to a smaller cloud.

eligibility_summary: Any new GCP account; CC required
free_tier_summary: Always-Free (Compute Engine e2-micro 1 instance/mo in us-west1/east1/central1, Cloud Storage 5 GB, Cloud Functions 2M invocations, Firestore 1 GB + 50k reads/day, BigQuery 1 TB queries/mo, Cloud Run 2M req/mo). Plus $300 USD signup credits good for 90 days.
headline: GCP free tier — always-free + $300 / 90-day credits for new accounts.
name: Google Cloud Free Tier
notes: Always-free Compute is US-region-only — Mumbai (asia-south1) is paid. Use the $300 credits in any region while they last. After 90 days only Always-Free continues; rest stops billing OR converts to paid (your choice at signup).
region_summary: US-only on free; all on credits
restrictions: Always-free Compute Engine + Storage are US-only. Crossing $300 credit triggers paid billing if you opted in. Free Compute requires manual upgrade-to-paid choice at credit-end.

sub_offerings.headline: Compute e2-micro (US), Cloud Storage 5 GB, Functions 2M req, Run 2M req, Firestore 1 GB
$300 USD usable across all services for 90 days

limits.auto_charge_after_credit: Only if you upgraded to paid during the trial

tier_fit_rationale: Always-free is small but stable. The $300 / 90-day credit is the real win — enough to run a Series-A-quality stack for 3 months while you decide.

eligibility_summary: Any new Oracle account; CC required
free_tier_summary: Always Free: 4 ARM Ampere A1 OCPUs + 24 GB RAM (split across up to 4 VMs), 2x AMD VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro instances, 200 GB block storage, 10 TB egress/month, 2x Autonomous Databases (20 GB each), 10 GB object storage, Always Free Load Balancer. Plus $300 / 30-day signup credits.
headline: Oracle Cloud's always-free is the most generous of any public cloud — 4 ARM cores + 24 GB RAM + 200 GB storage forever.
name: Oracle Cloud Always Free
notes: Reclaims always-free resources after 30 days of inactivity (no CPU/network usage). Mumbai (ap-mumbai-1) supports always-free but ARM A1 capacity is sometimes exhausted — retry over hours/days. ResourceOS migration target if Render free-tier triggers fire.
restrictions: ARM A1 capacity reclaimed if idle 30+ days. Some regions occasionally reject A1 provisioning due to capacity. Account suspension reported (rare) when sustained 100% CPU looks abusive.

sub_offerings.headline: 4 ARM cores + 24 GB RAM, 200 GB block, 10 TB egress, 2 Autonomous DBs, Load Balancer
$300 USD usable across all services for 30 days

tier_fit_rationale: Best free-tier compute by an order of magnitude. 4 ARM cores + 24 GB RAM trivially runs FastAPI + Next.js + Postgres + Redis + scrapers all on one VM. Can host pre-seed startups for $0 forever — provided you accept Oracle's signup friction and reclamation policy.
